text: BEAT ALL STAGES TO COMPLETE THE LEVEL.
MOVE FORWARD. JUMP OVER OBSTACLES. TRY NOT TO FALL.
YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH THE ABILITY TO DOUBLE JUMP.
PRESS JUMP AGAIN WHILE AIRBORNE TO PERFORM A SECOND JUMP.
'Beat the level...? Why do i have to play this?.'
THE FURTHER YOU PROGRESS, THE MORE DIFFICULT THE STAGES WILL BECOME.
SOME OBSTACLES MAY REQUIRE A LITTLE MORE... ATTENTION.
AVOID ALL PROJECTILES. THEY WILL RESET YOU TO THE START WHEN TOUCHED.
THAT'S ALL YOU NEED TO KNOW.
